note: Proposed behavior tests for later implementation. None of these exist in the repo yet. Do not treat this file as a Vitest config.

tests.behavior: Team form windows use only approved official contributions
tests.given: A team with 12 official matched contributions and 3 unmatched ProviderMatch rows
tests.when: Analytics builds form for last 5, 10, and 20
tests.then: Windows contain only official matched W/D/L in scheduled order. Length is min(window, official count). Unmatched rows are absent.

tests.behavior: Player percentiles are cohort ranks, not forecasts
tests.given: Official PlayerCompetitionStats for one position in a competition
tests.when: Analytics ranks rating and goals per 90
tests.then: Each player gets a percentile in [0, 100] against that position cohort. Unmatched and ineligible rows are excluded. Output has no predicted future value.

tests.behavior: Trends follow jornada or scheduledStartAt from scheduling, not contribution insert order
tests.given: Official contributions whose encounter ids map to rounds 1 then 3 then 2
tests.when: RebuildAnalyticsSnapshot runs
tests.then: Trend series is ordered by Encounter.scheduledStartAt then roundId. Missing kickoff on the contribution itself is filled through a reader port.

tests.behavior: Replay of the same official revision does not duplicate snapshots
tests.given: An AnalyticsSnapshot already built for officialResultId+revision
tests.when: The same official-result-approved or rebuild runs again
tests.then: One snapshot remains. Aggregates are identical.

tests.behavior: Voided official results drop out of premium aggregates
tests.given: A snapshot that included revision N
tests.when: The official result is voided and statistics reproject
tests.then: The next analytics rebuild omits that revision. Form and percentiles recompute from remaining approved rows.

tests.behavior: Home and away splits use TeamMatchContribution.side
tests.given: Matched home and away official rows for one team
tests.when: Team analytics computes local vs visitante
tests.then: Each split only includes its side. Totals of both splits equal the official matched count.

tests.behavior: Confirm HTTP does not project official stats yet
tests.given: Encounter HTTP routes in apps/api
tests.when: A client confirms an official selection through product HTTP
tests.then: No route calls confirmOfficialSelectionAndProject. EventPublisherPort remains NoopEventPublisher. Analytics rebuild must not assume a live confirm-to-project path until HTTP is wired.

tests.behavior: Premium entitlement is decided on the server
tests.given: An organization with premiumAnalytics false and a member actor
tests.when: GetTeamAnalytics (or require entitlement) runs with a client-supplied plan=premium
tests.then: The use case ignores the client plan and returns analytics.entitlement_required.

tests.behavior: Missing RBAC is forbidden, not a payment miss
tests.given: An actor with no competition membership in org B, which has premium on
tests.when: The actor requests org B team analytics
tests.then: Result is analytics.read_forbidden. No snapshot fields leak.

tests.behavior: EffectiveAccess exposes analytics.read as allowed false on free plan without granting data
tests.given: A member of a free organization
tests.when: GET /authorization/effective-access asks for analytics.read
tests.then: permissions includes analytics.read allowed false or omits it as not allowed. No analytics payload is returned on this route.

tests.behavior: Grant allow without org entitlement still lacks the plan
tests.given: A staff grant allow analytics.read on a free organization
tests.when: Require premium analytics
tests.then: Entitlement fails (402 path). RBAC may be allowed. Both axes are recorded in the error code.

tests.behavior: Flag flip is visible on the next EffectiveAccess read
tests.given: An organizer who just enabled the premium analytics flag
tests.when: getEffectiveAccess runs again in the same scope
tests.then: analytics.read is allowed true if role bundles include it. No client cache is treated as source of truth.

tests.behavior: Premium must not reuse statistics.read-own
tests.given: An authenticated outsider with no org membership
tests.when: The actor requests GET /players/me/analytics gated only by statistics.read-own
tests.then: The gate would allow them. Premium instead requires analytics.read (and entitlement if product keeps that axis). Outsiders stay denied.

tests.behavior: Role bundles do not auto-grant analytics.read to every organizer
tests.given: analytics.read is added to the analytics catalog
tests.when: ALL_PERMISSIONS is rebuilt and organizer and staff bundles are applied
tests.then: Organizer and staff are not granted analytics.read unless the matrix explicitly includes it. Superuser still receives every catalog permission at platform.

tests.behavior: Unauthenticated premium reads are 401
tests.given: No session and no service auth
tests.when: GET a premium analytics path
tests.then: 401 with the existing api unauthorized code. No snapshot body.

tests.behavior: Free-plan member receives typed 402
tests.given: Service-auth actor who is a member of org A with premium off
tests.when: GET team, player, or organizer analytics for org A
tests.then: HTTP 402, code analytics.entitlement_required, messageKey errors.analytics.entitlement_required. statusForFailureCode maps that code to 402.

tests.behavior: Cross-tenant read is 403 without confirming the resource
tests.given: Two organizations. Actor belongs only to org A. Org B has premium snapshots.
tests.when: GET org B analytics with a guessed competition id
tests.then: 403 analytics.read_forbidden or equivalent not-found-without-leak per AC-SEC-001. No row counts from org B.

tests.behavior: Premium 200 returns official-derived fields only
tests.given: Entitled actor and a rebuilt snapshot
tests.when: GET team, player, and organizer analytics
tests.then: Bodies parse with api-contracts. No EA payload, candidate ids, dispute text, or provider secrets. The player me analytics route is self-only.

tests.behavior: GET is idempotent and does not rebuild as a side effect of a second call
tests.given: A snapshot at revision N
tests.when: Two GETs in a row
tests.then: Identical bodies. No duplicate analytics.snapshot-generated events.

tests.behavior: Invalid query is 400 validation, not 402
tests.given: An entitled actor
tests.when: GET with an empty competitionId or an unknown window
tests.then: 400 api.validation_error. Zod issues only.

tests.behavior: Premium paths nest under existing resources
tests.given: Current API path convention
tests.when: Contracts register team, player, and organizer analytics
tests.then: Paths are nested under players, organizations, competitions, or teams. No /premium/ prefix. /internal/ stays platform-admin.

tests.behavior: Browser GETs go through web BFF, not a public SDK client
tests.given: A signed-in browser session
tests.when: The dashboard fetches premium analytics
tests.then: Same-origin /api/v1 with cookies. A BFF file exists for the new path. getFutrobBrowserClient is not the product path. Do not assume standings BFF exists as a template. It does not.

tests.behavior: 402 details stay inside apiErrorDetailsSchema
tests.given: A free-plan member hitting a premium GET
tests.when: The API returns analytics.entitlement_required
tests.then: HTTP 402. Extra plan or feature fields are either absent or added to apiErrorDetailsSchema first. Closed .strict() must not silently drop them. OpenAPI lists 402 after generate:openapi.

tests.behavior: Locked empty state when entitlement is missing
tests.given: A signed-in player whose EffectiveAccess denies analytics.read
tests.when: They open the premium team or player dashboard
tests.then: EmptyState explains the lock. No trend numbers from a prior cache. Nav Analíticas is hidden or disabled. Direct URL still hits the API gate.

tests.behavior: Ready dashboard shows official trends, percentiles, form, comparisons
tests.given: 200 from the premium team and player endpoints
tests.when: The dashboard renders
tests.then: Stat uses the perfil composition from design.md. Form windows 5, 10, 20 are official. No PlayerGameProfileDto series. No prediction copy.

tests.behavior: Partial official data is not shown as zero
tests.given: A snapshot with partial flags on shots
tests.when: The dashboard renders percentiles for shots
tests.then: Muted StatValue uses the unknown placeholder from design.md. Not 0.

tests.behavior: Locales and deep links
tests.given: es default and en toggle
tests.when: The user changes locale and the competition or team search params
tests.then: Copy comes from live catalogs.ts keys, not leftover messages/*.json. URL keeps the selection after reload.

tests.behavior: Un-stubbing Analíticas requires a real route
tests.given: competitionNav analytics item with stub true
tests.when: The premium dashboard ships
tests.then: A route file exists at the competition analytics path. stub is false. onClick is not a no-op. Permission is analytics.read, not competitions.read.

tests.behavior: Organizer KPIs match the gated organizer analytics DTO
tests.given: Entitled organizer and a 200 organizer analytics body
tests.when: The org or competition panel renders
tests.then: Calendar compliance, dispute count, reschedule count, data-quality, and provider status equal the DTO. No second client-side aggregation from foreign endpoints.

tests.behavior: Staff without entitlement sees 402, not superuser health
tests.given: Staff actor, premium off
tests.when: They open the organizer analytics panel
tests.then: EmptyState for entitlement. GET /internal/game-data/providers/:key/health is not called.

tests.behavior: KPI counts are organization scoped
tests.given: Open schedule-change requests in org A and org B
tests.when: Organizer analytics for org A runs
tests.then: Reschedule count equals org A only. Dispute count uses SelectionStatus in org A only.

tests.behavior: Provider status is coarse and sanitized
tests.given: A degraded ProviderHealthSnapshot
tests.when: The organizer panel shows salud del proveedor
tests.then: Status is healthy, degraded, or unavailable. No requestId, jobId, or upstream body.

tasks.tarea: [UX] IA de la primera capa premium (sin predicciones)

tests.behavior: IA names three first-layer surfaces and their states
tests.given: The UX deliverable
tests.when: A UI implementer reads it
tests.then: Team, player, and organizer surfaces list routes, Stat composition, and states loading, empty official data, partial, forbidden, entitlement missing, ready.

tests.behavior: Metric inventory excludes predictions
tests.given: PRD section 14 and WONT-06
tests.when: The IA lists metrics
tests.then: Trends, percentiles, form, comparisons, and organizer ops are in. Predicted winners, expected goals, and AI advice are out.

tests.behavior: Locked premium copy is specified in es and en
tests.given: Entitlement missing and permission missing as two states
tests.when: Copy is listed
tests.then: 402 and 403 have distinct sentence-case captions in catalogs.ts. No raw error codes in the heading. Leftover `messages/*.json` is not the source.

tests.behavior: First premium layer sits in competition context
tests.given: design.md navigation IA
tests.when: The UX names where Analíticas lives
tests.then: Team and organizer premium are competition-context (or org) surfaces. They are not folded into personal General. Mis estadísticas stays the EA personal page unless a separate official or premium player route is named.

tests.behavior: Forbidden is not an empty-data state
tests.given: design.md 403 con salida segura
tests.when: The IA lists dashboard states
tests.then: Forbidden, entitlement missing, and empty official data are three distinct EmptyState recipes. Forbidden includes a safe exit. Empty data does not look like a lock.
